+# JSON-RPC errors that a retry of the same request cannot fix. INTERNAL_ERROR,
+# timeouts and unknown codes stay retryable. Each stateless activity opens a new
+# connection, so a lost session is retried on a fresh one and needs no exception.
+_NON_RETRYABLE_PROTOCOL_ERRORS = frozenset(
+    {PARSE_ERROR, INVALID_REQUEST, METHOD_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_PARAMS}
+)
+
+
+def _protocol_error(err: McpError) -> ApplicationError:
+    """Convert an MCP protocol error to an ``ApplicationError``.
+
+    Errors a retry cannot fix (invalid request/params, unknown method, parse
+    error) are non-retryable so the activity does not keep retrying them.
+    """
+    error = err.error
+    details = (error.code,) if error.data is None else (error.code, error.data)
+    return ApplicationError(
+        error.message,
+        *details,
+        type="MCPProtocolError",
+        non_retryable=error.code in _NON_RETRYABLE_PROTOCOL_ERRORS,
+    )
+
+

@@ -0,0 +1,92 @@
+import warnings
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+from mcp.types import (
+    INTERNAL_ERROR,
+    INVALID_PARAMS,
+    INVALID_REQUEST,
+    METHOD_NOT_FOUND,
+    PARSE_ERROR,
+)
+
+try:
+    from mcp import MCPError as McpError  # type: ignore[attr-defined]  # mcp>=2
+except ImportError:  # mcp<2
+    from mcp.shared.exceptions import McpError  # type: ignore[attr-defined,no-redef]
+
+from temporalio import activity
+from temporalio.exceptions import ApplicationError
+from temporalio.openai_agents import StatelessMCPServerProvider
+from temporalio.openai_agents._mcp import (
+    _StatelessCallToolsArguments,
+    _StatelessGetPromptArguments,
+    _StatelessListPromptsArguments,
+    _StatelessListToolsArguments,
+)
+
+
+class _FailingServer:
+    """Stand-in MCP server whose every operation raises ``McpError``."""
+
+    def __init__(self, error: Exception) -> None:
+        self._error = error
+        self.cleaned_up = False
+
+    async def connect(self) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    async def cleanup(self) -> None:
+        self.cleaned_up = True
+
+    async def list_tools(self, *_args: Any, **_kwargs: Any):
+        raise self._error
+
+    async def call_tool(self, *_args: Any, **_kwargs: Any):
+        raise self._error
+
+    async def list_prompts(self, *_args: Any, **_kwargs: Any):
+        raise self._error
+
+    async def get_prompt(self, *_args: Any, **_kwargs: Any):
+        raise self._error
+
+
+def _activity(server: _FailingServer, name: str):
+    with warnings.catch_warnings():
+        warnings.simplefilter("ignore", DeprecationWarning)
+        provider = StatelessMCPServerProvider("srv", lambda: server)  # type: ignore[arg-type,return-value]
+    for act in provider._get_activities():
+        if activity._Definition.must_from_callable(act).name == f"srv-stateless-{name}":
+            return act
+    raise AssertionError(name)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "code,retryable",
+    [
+        (PARSE_ERROR, False),
+        (INVALID_REQUEST, False),
+        (METHOD_NOT_FOUND, False),
+        (INVALID_PARAMS, False),
+        (INTERNAL_ERROR, True),
+    ],
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "operation,args",
+    [
+        ("list-tools", _StatelessListToolsArguments(None)),
+        ("call-tool-v2", _StatelessCallToolsArguments("t", {}, None)),
+        ("list-prompts", _StatelessListPromptsArguments(None)),
+        ("get-prompt-v2", _StatelessGetPromptArguments("p", {}, None)),
+    ],
+)
+async def test_stateless_mcp_protocol_error_retryability(
+    code: int, retryable: bool, operation: str, args: Any
+) -> None:
+    server = _FailingServer(McpError(code, "boom"))
+    with pytest.raises(ApplicationError) as exc:
+        await _activity(server, operation)(args)
+    assert exc.value.type == "MCPProtocolError"
+    assert exc.value.non_retryable is (not retryable)
+    assert server.cleaned_up
